Market today: The mood is cautious. Rising Treasury yields, hitting levels not seen since 2007, are the real driver. This signals potential Fed rate hikes, which typically hurt growth and tech names like yours by making future earnings less valuable.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.87%) and SPAL (-36.78%) are leveraged ETFs with significant losses, both trading well below their default stops. QQQ (-1.31%), SMH (-14.82%), and QQQI (-4.35%) are also trading below their stops and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. Any further spikes could put more pressure on your tech-heavy book. Also, watch for any signs of a bounce in the broader market indices (SPY, QQQ) to see if the yield pressure eases.

Bottom line: The rising yield environment is a significant headwind; focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underwater positions.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (current price 102.14) and SPAL (current price 15.9) given their deep losses, leveraged nature, and being far below their stops.
Respect the stops on QQQ (670), SMH (540), and QQQI (52) as they are currently trading below these levels.
If looking to hedge your chip exposure, consider SOXS long at entry 51.15-51.1 with a stop at 50.95, as the scanner shows a long setup.
